extern_c.why: ggml's public header is C; C++ code includes it inside extern "C" so names are not mangled

block_q4_0.why: a quantised block: a plain struct with a fixed byte layout, checked at compile time

tensor.why: a tensor is a struct of sizes, byte strides and a raw data pointer

tensor_data.why: the raw pointer to the tensor's bytes

mmap.why: model weights are mapped from the GGUF file into memory, not read

deleters.why: RAII around the C API: a deleter struct ...

unique_ptr.why: ... and a unique_ptr that calls it when the owner goes out of scope

template_dup.why: a C++ template: one copy of the function per (source, destination) type pair

threads.why: the CPU backend's threads are plain POSIX threads behind C macros

ith_nth.why: each op splits its rows by thread index and thread count
ith_nth.text:
const int ith = params->ith; // thread index
    const int nth = params->nth; // number of threads

simd.why: the same dot product with ARM NEON intrinsics, 16 bytes at a time

cmake.why: backends are chosen at build time with CMake options

dot_generic.why: the portable reference loop: unpack two 4-bit weights per byte, multiply, accumulate
